editorial:
You get pulled right back into the deadly game with Zoey and Ben, two survivors who thought they were done. This time, the rooms are bigger, meaner, and built for people who already know how to win. The group is made of past champions, so every puzzle feels personal and every mistake costs more. ” moments.

The action moves quickly, the traps look sharp, and the cast sells the panic without going over the top. The rooms keep changing, so you never settle in, and the puzzles stay easy to follow. Some twists feel a little too neat, and a few characters do not get enough time to shine. Still, if you like puzzle thrillers, this is a fun ride.
endingExplained: Zoey and Ben think they have escaped, but the final twist reveals the whole game was still running. The villain behind the rooms traps them again and makes it clear they are not free. The movie ends with them back in danger, setting up another round instead of giving a clean win. It is a dark, open ending that leaves you wondering if anyone can truly beat the system.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves puzzle thrillers and escape room movies.
